purpose: Define the minimal solver-facing dynamic surface-boundary evaluation needed to reproduce the restricted legacy B1.10 atmospheric boundary without using HeadCalc globals as an API.

evaluation_inputs.candidate_ponding_depth_cm: trial-local current pond value used by legacy pondrunoff iteration
evaluation_inputs.ponding_max_cm: static runoff threshold in first admitted profile
evaluation_inputs.runoff_exponent: must equal 1 within admitted active-runoff profile

evaluation_outputs.surface_face_conductivity_cm_per_day: required by residual and Jacobian in head regime
evaluation_outputs.candidate_ponding_depth_cm: trial-local surface storage after boundary evaluation
evaluation_outputs.runoff_depth_cm: legacy runots equivalent over the current internal step
evaluation_outputs.net_potential_surface_flux_cm_per_day: legacy q0 equivalent for diagnostics/mass reconciliation

mapping_to_reference_richards: FLUX => ftoph=false and F(1) receives actual_top_flux
PRESCRIBED_SURFACE_HEAD => ftoph=true and F(1)/J(1,1) use surface_head plus surface_face_conductivity
candidate ponding and runoff remain trial-local until solve acceptance
evaporation outputs are accepted process flux metadata, not persistent solver scratch
rejected/retried trial publishes none of these outputs
why_current_interface_fails: provider cannot return surface-face conductivity required by head-regime residual/Jacobian
accepted ponding and evaporation partition are absent from the current provider result surface
